title: One Megakernel is Not Enough: Predicting Where to Cut for Streaming Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.35336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We address a fundamental question: How far should kernel fusion extend and which boundaries are worth preserving? Unlike the general convention of using one monolith megakernel at lower batch sizes or supporting only a selective model component as megakernel and rest of the model as conventional graph, we show that the best configuration is a composition of multiple megakernels with no overlapping conventional graph component, or a fully conventional graph. We present a framework that selects megakernel regions in a streaming inference model from conventional-graph profiles and standalone kernel benchmarks, without running any candidate design end to end. It simulates each candidate's tile and event graphs to predict time to first output and selects the measured best design in all 13 combinations of model and batch size we tested. translated_title: 单一兆内核并不足够：预测流式推理中的切分位置
translated_abstract: 我们探讨了一个根本性问题：内核融合应该延伸到什么程度，哪些边界值得保留？与在小批量（batch size）场景下普遍使用单一单体兆内核（megakernel），或仅将部分模型组件作为兆内核而其余部分保持为常规计算图的做法不同，我们证明了最佳配置是由多个兆内核组成、且不包含重叠的常规计算图组件，或者完全采用常规计算图。我们提出了一个框架，它能基于常规计算图的性能剖析（profile）和独立内核基准测试，为流式推理模型选择兆内核区域，而无需端到端地运行任何候选设计。该框架通过模拟每个候选设计的瓦片图（tile graph）和事件图（event graph）来预测首个输出的生成时间，并在我们测试的全部13种模型与批量大小的组合中，都成功选出了实测最优的设计。在NH-TTS、Qwen3-TTS和Llama-1B上，最佳组合从两到四个兆内核到完全常规计算图不等。
tldr: 该研究表明流式推理的最优配置既不是单一单体兆内核也不是固定的部分融合方案，而是由两到四个兆内核组合或完全常规计算图构成，并提出了一个无需端到端运行候选设计、仅通过模拟瓦片图和事件图即可在13种模型与批量组合中全部选出实测最优设计的预测框架。
en_tdlr: The best streaming inference configuration is neither a single monolithic megakernel nor a fixed partial-fusion scheme, but a composition of two to four megakernels or a fully conventional graph, and the proposed framework predicts the measured-best design across all 13 model and batch-size combinations by simulating tile and event graphs without any end-to-end runs.
